title: Learning Rewards in Strategic Games
title_zh: 策略游戏中的奖励学习

paragraphs.en: Understanding the objectives that drive agents’ behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents’ underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of strategic identifiability , and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples K K . Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower’s reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of K − 1 / 2 K^{-1/2} . Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance. 1 1 1 The code is made available at https://github.com/ALPIuzh/learning-rewards-in-strategic-games .
paragraphs.zh: 在多个智能体相互作用并相互适应的策略性环境中，理解驱动智能体行为的目标至关重要。 这一挑战出现在网络安全、自动驾驶和在线市场等领域，在这些领域中，智能体的底层激励通常是未知的，必须从其观察到的行为中推断出来。 逆强化学习（IRL）为该问题提供了一个自然的框架，但将 IRL 扩展到策略性多智能体设定会引入一个根本性挑战：一个能解释观察到的行为的奖励，在用于决策时未必能诱导出最优策略。 在本工作中，我们通过策略可辨识性的视角研究这一问题，并表明仅从固定的策略对中学习可能不足以在策略意义上辨识奖励，且这与专家样本数量 K K 无关。 受此启发，我们为双人重复斯塔克尔伯格博弈引入了一种主动 IRL 算法，其中领导者自适应地选择策略，以引出关于跟随者奖励的信息性响应。 结合极大似然估计与实验设计，我们推导了由所学奖励诱导的斯塔克尔伯格次优性的有限样本保证，在多对数因子范围内匹配了一个新的 K − 1 / 2 K^{-1/2} 极小极大学习速率。 最后，我们在一个真实的反盗猎场景中评估了我们的方法，展示了主动探索在奖励恢复及下游策略性能方面的优势。 1 1 1 代码已在 https://github.com/ALPIuzh/learning-rewards-in-strategic-games 公开。

paragraphs.en: Strategic decision-making often requires reasoning about agents whose objectives are unknown. A defender may need to anticipate the incentives of an attacker, an autonomous vehicle the preferences of other drivers, or a wildlife-protection agency the objectives of poachers. In such settings, agents’ behavior provides an indirect signal about their underlying incentives. Recovering these objectives is valuable not only for explaining observed behavior, but, crucially, for predicting how agents may respond to new policies or interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 战略决策常常需要对目标未知的智能体进行推理。 防御者可能需要预判攻击者的动机，自动驾驶汽车需要预判其他司机的偏好，野生动物保护机构需要预判偷猎者的目标。 在这类情境中，智能体的行为为其潜在动机提供了间接信号。 推断这些目标不仅有助于解释已观察到的行为，更重要的是，有助于预测智能体在面对新政策或干预时可能作出的反应。

paragraphs.en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) ( Ng et al., 2000 ; Abbeel and Ng, 2004 ) provides a natural framework for inferring latent reward functions from the behavior of approximately optimal agents. While IRL has been extensively studied in single-agent decision-making, strategic interactions fundamentally change the problem. An agent’s observed behavior depends not only on its own reward, but also on the behavior of the agents it interacts with. Consequently, a reward that perfectly explains behavior under one interaction may fail to predict how the same agent responds when its opponent changes strategy. This raises a fundamental question for IRL in games:
paragraphs.zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）（Ng et al., 2000；Abbeel and Ng, 2004）为从近似最优智能体的行为中推断潜在奖励函数提供了一个自然的框架。 尽管逆强化学习在单智能体决策中已被广泛研究，但策略性交互从根本上改变了这个问题。 一个智能体被观察到的行为不仅取决于它自身的奖励，还取决于与其交互的其他智能体的行为。 因此，在一种交互下能完美解释行为的奖励，在对手改变策略时可能无法预测同一智能体如何回应。 这为博弈中的逆强化学习提出了一个根本性问题：

sents.en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) ( Ng et al., 2000 ; Abbeel and Ng, 2004 ) provides a natural framework for inferring latent reward functions from the behavior of approximately optimal agents.
sents.zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）（Ng et al., 2000；Abbeel and Ng, 2004）为从近似最优智能体的行为中推断潜在奖励函数提供了一个自然的框架。

sents.en: While IRL has been extensively studied in single-agent decision-making, strategic interactions fundamentally change the problem.
sents.zh: 尽管逆强化学习在单智能体决策中已被广泛研究，但策略性交互从根本上改变了这个问题。

sents.en: An agent’s observed behavior depends not only on its own reward, but also on the behavior of the agents it interacts with.
sents.zh: 一个智能体被观察到的行为不仅取决于它自身的奖励，还取决于与其交互的其他智能体的行为。

sents.en: Consequently, a reward that perfectly explains behavior under one interaction may fail to predict how the same agent responds when its opponent changes strategy.
sents.zh: 因此，在一种交互下能完美解释行为的奖励，在对手改变策略时可能无法预测同一智能体如何回应。

sents.en: This raises a fundamental question for IRL in games:
sents.zh: 这为博弈中的逆强化学习提出了一个根本性问题：

paragraphs.en: when does observed behavior contain enough information about an agent’s reward to support reliable strategic decision-making?
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的行为何时包含关于智能体奖励的足够信息，以支持可靠的策略性决策？

paragraphs.en: Rather than requiring recovery of the ground-truth reward itself, we argue that reward learning should preserve the strategic consequences that matter at deployment. We study this question through the lens of strategic identifiability , relating ambiguity in the inferred reward to the sub-optimality incurred when using it for downstream strategic decision-making. We illustrate this objective in Figure 1 for a wildlife protection application, where an error in reward estimation from a ranger patrol can incur highly sub-optimal behavior at deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，奖励学习不需要恢复真实奖励本身，而应保留在部署时具有重要意义的策略性后果。 我们通过策略可辨识性（strategic identifiability）的视角研究这一问题，将推断出的奖励中的歧义与其在用于下游策略决策时造成的次优程度联系起来。 我们在图 1 中以野生动物保护应用为例说明这一目标，在该应用中，护林员巡逻所得到的奖励估计误差可能在部署时导致高度次优的行为。

sents.en: Rather than requiring recovery of the ground-truth reward itself, we argue that reward learning should preserve the strategic consequences that matter at deployment.
sents.zh: 我们认为，奖励学习不需要恢复真实奖励本身，而应保留在部署时具有重要意义的策略性后果。

sents.en: We study this question through the lens of strategic identifiability , relating ambiguity in the inferred reward to the sub-optimality incurred when using it for downstream strategic decision-making.
sents.zh: 我们通过策略可辨识性（strategic identifiability）的视角研究这一问题，将推断出的奖励中的歧义与其在用于下游策略决策时造成的次优程度联系起来。

sents.en: We illustrate this objective in Figure 1 for a wildlife protection application, where an error in reward estimation from a ranger patrol can incur highly sub-optimal behavior at deployment.
sents.zh: 我们在图 1 中以野生动物保护应用为例说明这一目标，在该应用中，护林员巡逻所得到的奖励估计误差可能在部署时导致高度次优的行为。

paragraphs.en: A key difficulty is that passive observations may provide insufficient information for this objective. Observing an agent repeatedly against a fixed policy only reveals its preferences under that particular interaction. Distinct reward functions may therefore generate indistinguishable behavior while inducing substantially different responses to alternative policies. As we show in this work, this can prevent low strategic sub-optimality even with infinitely many observations. This limitation suggests a different approach: rather than passively observing strategic behavior, can we actively choose interactions that reveal the reward information needed for downstream decision-making?
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键难点在于，被动观察可能无法为这一目标提供足够的信息。 在固定策略下反复观察一个智能体，只能揭示其在该特定交互下的偏好。 因此，不同的奖励函数可能产生难以区分的行为，同时对其他策略引发截然不同的反应。 正如我们在本工作中所示，即使拥有无限多次观察，这也可能阻碍低战略次优性的实现。 这一局限提示了一种不同的思路：与其被动观察策略性行为，我们能否主动选择交互方式，以揭示下游决策所需的奖励信息？

sents.en: A key difficulty is that passive observations may provide insufficient information for this objective.
sents.zh: 一个关键难点在于，被动观察可能无法为这一目标提供足够的信息。

sents.en: Observing an agent repeatedly against a fixed policy only reveals its preferences under that particular interaction.
sents.zh: 在固定策略下反复观察一个智能体，只能揭示其在该特定交互下的偏好。

sents.en: Distinct reward functions may therefore generate indistinguishable behavior while inducing substantially different responses to alternative policies.
sents.zh: 因此，不同的奖励函数可能产生难以区分的行为，同时对其他策略引发截然不同的反应。

sents.en: As we show in this work, this can prevent low strategic sub-optimality even with infinitely many observations.
sents.zh: 正如我们在本工作中所示，即使拥有无限多次观察，这也可能阻碍低战略次优性的实现。

sents.en: This limitation suggests a different approach: rather than passively observing strategic behavior, can we actively choose interactions that reveal the reward information needed for downstream decision-making?
sents.zh: 这一局限提示了一种不同的思路：与其被动观察策略性行为，我们能否主动选择交互方式，以揭示下游决策所需的奖励信息？

paragraphs.en: We answer this question in repeated Stackelberg games, where a leader can adaptively select policies and observe the responses of a bounded-rational follower. This setting naturally allows the leader to trade off exploiting its current estimate of the follower’s reward with selecting interactions that are informative about the follower’s underlying objectives. We develop an active IRL approach that combines maximum-likelihood reward estimation with experimental design to progressively resolve strategically relevant reward ambiguity, and we provide finite-sample guarantees on the strategic performance induced by the learned reward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在重复斯塔克尔伯格博弈中回答这一问题，其中领导者可以自适应地选择策略，并观察有限理性追随者的反应。 这一设定自然地允许领导者在利用其对追随者奖励的当前估计，与选择能够揭示追随者潜在目标信息的交互之间进行权衡。 我们提出了一种主动式逆强化学习方法，该方法将最大似然奖励估计与实验设计相结合，以逐步消除与策略相关的奖励歧义，并针对由学到的奖励所诱导的策略性能给出了有限样本保证。

sents.en: We answer this question in repeated Stackelberg games, where a leader can adaptively select policies and observe the responses of a bounded-rational follower.
sents.zh: 我们在重复斯塔克尔伯格博弈中回答这一问题，其中领导者可以自适应地选择策略，并观察有限理性追随者的反应。

sents.en: This setting naturally allows the leader to trade off exploiting its current estimate of the follower’s reward with selecting interactions that are informative about the follower’s underlying objectives.
sents.zh: 这一设定自然地允许领导者在利用其对追随者奖励的当前估计，与选择能够揭示追随者潜在目标信息的交互之间进行权衡。

sents.en: We develop an active IRL approach that combines maximum-likelihood reward estimation with experimental design to progressively resolve strategically relevant reward ambiguity, and we provide finite-sample guarantees on the strategic performance induced by the learned reward.
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种主动式逆强化学习方法，该方法将最大似然奖励估计与实验设计相结合，以逐步消除与策略相关的奖励歧义，并针对由学到的奖励所诱导的策略性能给出了有限样本保证。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our main contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们总结我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We formalize the objective of IRL in games in terms of the strategic performance induced by the learned reward. We show that observations generated by a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to identify a strategically useful reward, even with infinitely many samples (Lemma 2 ), while on hard instances any adaptive sampling strategy must suffer a Stackelberg sub-optimality lower bounded by Ω ( K − 1 / 2 ) \Omega(K^{-1/2}) after K K observations (Theorem 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从学习到的奖励所诱导的策略表现出发，形式化定义了博弈中逆强化学习（IRL）的目标。 我们证明，由固定策略对生成的观测数据可能不足以识别出具有策略价值的奖励，即使样本数量无穷多也是如此（引理 2）；而在困难实例上，任何自适应采样策略在获得 K K 次观测后，其 Stackelberg 次优性下界为 Ω ( K − 1 / 2 ) \Omega(K^{-1/2})（定理 1）。

sents.en: We formalize the objective of IRL in games in terms of the strategic performance induced by the learned reward.
sents.zh: 我们从学习到的奖励所诱导的策略表现出发，形式化定义了博弈中逆强化学习（IRL）的目标。

sents.en: We show that observations generated by a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to identify a strategically useful reward, even with infinitely many samples (Lemma 2 ), while on hard instances any adaptive sampling strategy must suffer a Stackelberg sub-optimality lower bounded by Ω ( K − 1 / 2 ) \Omega(K^{-1/2}) after K K observations (Theorem 1 ).
sents.zh: 我们证明，由固定策略对生成的观测数据可能不足以识别出具有策略价值的奖励，即使样本数量无穷多也是如此（引理 2）；而在困难实例上，任何自适应采样策略在获得 K K 次观测后，其 Stackelberg 次优性下界为 Ω ( K − 1 / 2 ) \Omega(K^{-1/2})（定理 1）。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this impossibility, we introduce an active IRL framework for repeated Stackelberg normal-form games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses from a bounded-rational follower with linear rewards. Our algorithm combines maximum-likelihood reward estimation with experimental design and achieves a high-probability Stackelberg sub-optimality of order 𝒪 ~ ​ ( d / K ) \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/\sqrt{K}) after K K interactions where d d is the dimensionality of the follower features (Theorem 3 ). This matches the optimal dependence on K K up to polylogarithmic factors.
paragraphs.zh: 受这种不可能性结果的启发，我们针对重复 Stackelberg 标准型博弈提出了一个主动 IRL 框架，其中领导者自适应地选择策略，以从具有线性奖励的有限理性跟随者那里引出有信息量的响应。 我们的算法将最大似然奖励估计与实验设计相结合，并在 K 次交互后以高概率实现量级为 𝒪 ~ ​ ( d / K ) \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/\sqrt{K}) 的 Stackelberg 次优性，其中 d 是跟随者特征的维度（定理 3）。 这在对 K 的依赖性上达到了最优（相差多对数因子）。

sents.en: Motivated by this impossibility, we introduce an active IRL framework for repeated Stackelberg normal-form games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses from a bounded-rational follower with linear rewards.
sents.zh: 受这种不可能性结果的启发，我们针对重复 Stackelberg 标准型博弈提出了一个主动 IRL 框架，其中领导者自适应地选择策略，以从具有线性奖励的有限理性跟随者那里引出有信息量的响应。

sents.en: Our algorithm combines maximum-likelihood reward estimation with experimental design and achieves a high-probability Stackelberg sub-optimality of order 𝒪 ~ ​ ( d / K ) \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/\sqrt{K}) after K K interactions where d d is the dimensionality of the follower features (Theorem 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们的算法将最大似然奖励估计与实验设计相结合，并在 K 次交互后以高概率实现量级为 𝒪 ~ ​ ( d / K ) \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/\sqrt{K}) 的 Stackelberg 次优性，其中 d 是跟随者特征的维度（定理 3）。

sents.en: This matches the optimal dependence on K K up to polylogarithmic factors.
sents.zh: 这在对 K 的依赖性上达到了最优（相差多对数因子）。

paragraphs.en: We then evaluate our approach on synthetic normal-form games and a realistic wildlife-protection environment. Our experiments demonstrate the benefits of actively selecting interactions for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们在合成的正规形式博弈和一个真实的野生动物保护环境中评估我们的方法。 我们的实验证明了主动选择交互对于奖励恢复和下游策略表现的好处。

sents.en: We then evaluate our approach on synthetic normal-form games and a realistic wildlife-protection environment.
sents.zh: 随后，我们在合成的正规形式博弈和一个真实的野生动物保护环境中评估我们的方法。

sents.en: Our experiments demonstrate the benefits of actively selecting interactions for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.
sents.zh: 我们的实验证明了主动选择交互对于奖励恢复和下游策略表现的好处。

paragraphs.en: Our work connects inverse reinforcement learning and learning in games. In single-agent settings, IRL has long studied the ambiguity inherent in recovering rewards from demonstrations ( Ng et al., 2000 ; Abbeel and Ng, 2004 ) . In multi-agent settings, recent work has focused on whether policies learned from demonstrations remain robust when interacting with strategic agents, typically through notions of exploitability ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Freihaut et al., 2026a ; Bergerault et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作将逆强化学习与博弈中的学习联系起来。 在单智能体设定中，逆强化学习（IRL）长期以来研究从演示中恢复奖励所固有的歧义性（Ng et al., 2000；Abbeel and Ng, 2004）。 在多智能体设定中，近期的工作聚焦于从演示中学到的策略在与策略性智能体交互时是否保持稳健，通常通过可利用性（exploitability）的概念来衡量（Tang et al., 2024；Freihaut et al., 2026a；Bergerault et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Our work connects inverse reinforcement learning and learning in games.
sents.zh: 我们的工作将逆强化学习与博弈中的学习联系起来。

sents.en: In single-agent settings, IRL has long studied the ambiguity inherent in recovering rewards from demonstrations ( Ng et al., 2000 ; Abbeel and Ng, 2004 ) .
sents.zh: 在单智能体设定中，逆强化学习（IRL）长期以来研究从演示中恢复奖励所固有的歧义性（Ng et al., 2000；Abbeel and Ng, 2004）。

sents.en: In multi-agent settings, recent work has focused on whether policies learned from demonstrations remain robust when interacting with strategic agents, typically through notions of exploitability ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Freihaut et al., 2026a ; Bergerault et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 在多智能体设定中，近期的工作聚焦于从演示中学到的策略在与策略性智能体交互时是否保持稳健，通常通过可利用性（exploitability）的概念来衡量（Tang et al., 2024；Freihaut et al., 2026a；Bergerault et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Emerging work on IRL in games has instead characterized sets of rewards compatible with observed strategic behavior ( Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026 ; Barbara et al., 2026 ) . We take a complementary perspective: rather than only characterizing which rewards are consistent with observed behavior, we ask which interactions provide the information needed to identify a strategically useful reward, and how such interactions can be actively selected with finite-sample guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 有关游戏中逆强化学习（IRL）的新兴研究转而刻画与观察到的策略行为相兼容的奖励集合（Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026；Barbara et al., 2026）。 我们采取一种互补的视角：不仅仅是刻画哪些奖励与观察到的行为相一致，我们还探讨哪些交互能够提供识别具有策略价值的奖励所需的信息，以及如何在有限样本保证下主动选择这类交互。

sents.en: Emerging work on IRL in games has instead characterized sets of rewards compatible with observed strategic behavior ( Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026 ; Barbara et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 有关游戏中逆强化学习（IRL）的新兴研究转而刻画与观察到的策略行为相兼容的奖励集合（Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026；Barbara et al., 2026）。

sents.en: We take a complementary perspective: rather than only characterizing which rewards are consistent with observed behavior, we ask which interactions provide the information needed to identify a strategically useful reward, and how such interactions can be actively selected with finite-sample guarantees.
sents.zh: 我们采取一种互补的视角：不仅仅是刻画哪些奖励与观察到的行为相一致，我们还探讨哪些交互能够提供识别具有策略价值的奖励所需的信息，以及如何在有限样本保证下主动选择这类交互。

paragraphs.en: This is appealing for two main reasons. First, when offline methods are used as a bootstrap to further policy optimization ( Macuglia et al., 2025 ; Wagenmaker et al., 2025 ) seeking a Nash equilibrium. Second, as a deployment guarantee with a fixed opponent, i.e. how much a player could improve by deviating when the other players are deployed without adapting to these deviations .
paragraphs.zh: 这在两个主要方面颇具吸引力。 首先，当离线方法被用作引导，以进一步进行寻求纳什均衡的策略优化时（Macuglia 等，2025；Wagenmaker 等，2025）。 其次，作为针对固定对手的部署保障，即当其他玩家在不适应这些偏离的情况下被部署时，某玩家通过偏离能获得多大改进。

paragraphs.en: However, when learning and deploying in the presence of adaptive strategic players, regret notions are oblivious , as they ignore how other agents will react to a change of policy ( Mertikopoulos, 2026 ) . To better measure this strategic coupling between the agents, we therefore take the perspective of a Stackelberg setting ( Sessa et al., 2020 ; Bai et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当在与适应性策略玩家共存的环境中学习和部署时，遗憾值概念是不敏感的，因为它忽略了其他智能体对策略变化的反应（Mertikopoulos, 2026）。 为了更好地衡量智能体之间的这种策略耦合，我们因此采用 Stackelberg 设定的视角（Sessa et al., 2020; Bai et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The above lemma is a geometric artifact built on the same degeneracy as exact non-identifiability. This degeneracy makes it impossible to learn information that could help distinguish between two, strategically unequal coefficients, even in the infinite-data regime. Observations from a passive leader can therefore be insufficient to recover strategy-preserving rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 上述引理是一个几何性的产物，其建立在与精确不可辨识性相同的退化之上。 这种退化使得即使在无限数据的情形下，也无法学到有助于区分两个在策略上不对等的系数的信息。 因此，来自被动领导者的观测可能不足以恢复保持策略的奖励。

paragraphs.en: In many applications, indeed, one can actively interact with the environment over time. Examples include cybersecurity settings where defenders adapt to strategic attackers and online platforms interacting with self-interested users. In those cases, the learner is not restricted to passively observing a fixed behavior, but can deliberately choose policies inducing diverse environments for the ν \nu -player.
paragraphs.zh: 事实上，在许多应用中，人们可以随时间主动与环境交互。 例如网络安全场景，防御者需要适应策略性的攻击者，以及与自利用户交互的在线平台。 在这些情况下，学习方不再局限于被动观察固定行为，而是可以有意识地选择策略，为 ν \nu 玩家诱导出多样的环境。

paragraphs.en: We empirically validate our algorithm on a realistic anti-poaching task from the GUARD benchmark ( Krever et al., 2026 ) . We simulate both active methods where the controllable leader interacts with a best-response follower and fixed-expert methods. These fixed-expert baselines rely on the strong assumption of a known Stackelberg or quantal-response equilibrium oracle that we sample from.

paragraphs.en: We study IRL for interactive agents in strategic games as the problem of learning reward functions that (approximately) preserve optimality of agents when deployed among strategic players. In two-player normal-form games under linearity and entropy-regularization assumptions, we develop an active algorithm that provably minimizes Stackelberg sub-optimality at a minimax optimal rate, ignoring polylogarithmic factors. We then empirically validate our algorithm on a realistic anti-poaching game and a set of synthetic environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究策略博弈中交互智能体的逆强化学习（IRL），将其视为学习奖励函数的问题，使得智能体在部署于策略型玩家之中时（近似地）保持最优性。 在双人正规型博弈中，在线性假设与熵正则化假设下，我们开发了一种主动算法，该算法可证明地最小化Stackelberg次优性，并达到极小极大最优速率（忽略多对数因子）。 随后，我们在一个现实中的反盗猎博弈以及一组合成环境上对算法进行了实证验证。

paragraphs.en: Future directions A current open problem is principled learning in dynamic games. Specifically, open challenges include the derivation of exploration strategies over states and the computation of reward estimators from trajectories (beyond strong myopic assumptions of previous works).

paragraphs.en: We review the literature most relevant to our problem, with a particular focus on reward identifiability and inverse reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们回顾了与我们的问题最相关的文献，特别关注奖励可辨识性与逆强化学习。

paragraphs.en: Strictly convex regularization of the objective, such as entropy, ensures the uniqueness of the optimal policies to any given set of rewards. Nevertheless, inverse RL remains ill-defined as rewards are invariant to potential shaping ( Ng et al., 1999 ) . This identifiability issue was studied in the seminal work of Cao et al. (2021) , later refined by Rolland et al. (2022) and Schlaginhaufen and Kamgarpour (2024) . More recently, Freihaut and Ramponi (2026) extends those results to games, showing that even the nature (e.g. collaborative or competitive) of a game cannot be determined from the feasible reward sets of an expert.
paragraphs.zh: 对目标函数进行严格凸的正则化（例如熵正则化）可确保在任意给定奖励集合下最优策略的唯一性。 然而，由于奖励在势函数塑形变换下保持不变（Ng et al., 1999），逆强化学习仍然是病态定义的。 这一可辨识性问题在 Cao 等人的开创性工作中得到了研究， (2021)，随后由 Rolland 等人 (2022) 以及 Schlaginhaufen 和 Kamgarpour (2024) 加以完善。 最近，Freihaut 和 Ramponi (2026) 将这些结果扩展到博弈场景，表明即使是博弈的性质（例如合作或竞争），也无法从专家的可行奖励集合中确定。

paragraphs.en: When considering multiple interacting agents, inverse RL aims to recover the individual rewards explaining their behaviors. To this end, Mehr et al. (2023) empirically extend the classical MaxEntIRL framework of Ziebart et al. (2008) to games, learning from demonstrations of a Nash equilibrium. Similarly, Liao et al. (2025) study reward recovery from samples of a fixed expert in two-player zero-sum game expert under coverability assumptions. Later, Barbara et al. (2026) derives sample complexity bounds for recovering the feasible reward set by sampling a fixed expert, evaluated in the Hausdorff distance. Under the strong assumption of oracle access to the loss gradient, Goktas et al. (2025) perform principled inverse multi-agent RL with parameter-dependent payoffs. All these settings assume access to reliable equilibrium demonstrations, i.e. that the game has been solved a-priori by a set of players we can learn from (e.g. humans). This is restrictive in many applications, particularly in non-cooperative games where a player must learn to act against an adversary with unknown incentives. This motivates our setting, in which a player learns to behave strategically in arbitrary downstream tasks, playing against a best-responding agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在考虑多个相互作用的智能体时，逆强化学习旨在恢复解释其行为的个体奖励。为此，Mehr 等人 （2023）在实证上将 Ziebart 等人的经典 MaxEntIRL 框架 （2008）扩展到博弈中，从纳什均衡的示范中学习。类似地，Liao 等人 （2025）在可覆盖性假设下，研究从二人零和博弈中固定专家的样本中恢复奖励。随后，Barbara 等人 （2026）通过采样固定专家，为恢复可行奖励集合推导出了样本复杂度界，并以 Hausdorff 距离进行评估。 在可以查询损失梯度预言机的强假设下，Goktas 等人 （2025）对具有依赖参数收益的问题进行了有原则的多智能体逆强化学习。 所有这些设置都假设可以获取可靠的均衡示范，即博弈已经先验地被一组可供学习的玩家（例如人类）求解。 这在许多应用中是受限的，尤其是在非合作博弈中，此时玩家必须学会针对具有未知激励的对手采取行动。 这激发了我们的设定：玩家在任意下游任务中学习策略性行为，并与一个最优回应的智能体对弈。

paragraphs.en: Closer to this setup, Chen et al. (2023) extract the reward function from observing the follower in a two-player Stackelberg scenario. By controlling a prescription announced by the leader, they are able to bound the suboptimality of the optimal leader of the estimated environment. In contrast, we assume that the leader directly commits to a policy (as opposed to a prescription), and actively select leader strategies via optimal design to bound the offline suboptimality objective. This has been studied by Chen et al. (2025) , where the convergence of their algorithm is studied in the asymptotic regime. Contrary to their work, we derive an algorithm with sample complexity analysis and a matching minimax lower bound. Previously, Wu et al. (2022) also studied bounded rationality in the context of Stackelberg Games. In particular, the authors show that observations are more informative from a QRE than a Nash equilibrium. This means that bounded rationality helps to be more robust against an irrational opponent. Under finite action spaces, this makes it possible to construct algorithms with exponential dependencies on neither the number of leader actions nor the number of follower actions.
paragraphs.zh: 与这一设置更接近的是，Chen 等人 （2023）通过观察双参与者 Stackelberg 场景中的跟随者来提取奖励函数。 通过控制领导者公布的处方，他们能够为估计环境中最优领导者的次优性设定界。 相比之下，我们假设领导者直接承诺一个策略（而非处方），并通过最优设计主动选择领导者策略来为离线次优性目标设定界。 这一问题已被 Chen 等人 （2025）研究过，他们在渐近状态下研究了其算法的收敛性。 与他们的工作相反，我们推导出了一种带有样本复杂度分析以及匹配的极小极大下界的算法。此前，Wu 等人 （2022）也在 Stackelberg 博弈的背景下研究了有限理性。 特别地，作者证明了来自 QRE 的观测比来自纳什均衡的观测更具信息量。 这意味着有限理性有助于在面对非理性对手时更具鲁棒性。 在有限动作空间下，这使得构造的算法在领导者动作数量和跟随者动作数量上都不存在指数级依赖成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Learning against unknown or adversarial opponents. Several works study learning in multi-agent environments with unknown or adaptive opponents, where non-stationarity and strategic interactions make learning particularly challenging. In particular, Sessa et al. (2020) consider learning effective strategies against unknown opponents, while more recent approaches use demonstrations to improve learning in strategic settings, as in DIML ( An and Du, 2026 ) . Other works study robustness against adversaries and worst-case behaviors during training ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . In contrast, we focus on reward learning under strategic interactions rather than solely on policy optimization or robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 在未知或对抗性对手面前进行学习。 若干工作研究了在具有未知或自适应对手的多智能体环境中的学习，其中非平稳性和策略性互动使得学习尤其具有挑战性。 特别是，Sessa 等人 （2020）考虑在未知对手面前学习有效策略，而较新的方法则利用演示来改进策略性场景中的学习，如 DIML（An 和 Du, 2026）。 另一些工作研究了训练过程中针对对手和最坏情况的鲁棒性（Liu 等， 2022）。 与之相比，我们关注的是策略性互动下的奖励学习，而不仅仅是策略优化或鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we expand below on the recent developments around adjacent tasks, such as multi-agent imitation learning, and contrast with the scope and goals of the present paper.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们在下文进一步阐述相邻任务（如多智能体模仿学习）的最新进展，并将其与本文的研究范围和目标进行对比。

paragraphs.en: Recent imitation learning works in games measure sub-optimality of the learned behavior by the notion of Nash gap, initially introduced by Ramponi et al. (2023) . In general Markov games, Tang et al. (2024) showed how harder this objective is compared to the common value gap extension from single-agent problems. Later, these remarks have been extended to more precise characterizations for imitation learning by Freihaut et al. (2026a) ; Freihaut et al. (2026b) ; Bergerault et al. (2026a) . In the non-interactive case, these works show that the hardness of equilibria extraction can be reduced to notions of concentrability and continuity at equilibrium. Further, Freihaut et al. (2026a) ; Freihaut et al. (2026b) show how to optimize such Nash gap regrets in the interactive setting by forcing the exploration of the state space to cover uncertain deviations. This is done by controlling all the agents sequentially. We argue that such control over the agents is not realistic in many scenarios, where agents are not collaborative in learning, e.g. in real world environments when learning from interactions with (partially) adversarial players. To this end, we adopt a Stackelberg objective to measure the optimality of extracted policies, evaluating a leader when deployed with other strategic players.
paragraphs.zh: 近期游戏中的模仿学习工作通过纳什间隙（Nash gap）来衡量所学习行为的次优性，该概念最初由 Ramponi 等人（2023）提出。 在一般马尔可夫博弈中，Tang 等人 （2024）展示了该目标相比从单智能体问题延伸而来的常见价值间隙指标有多大难度。 后来，Freihaut 等人 （2026a）；Freihaut 等人 （2026b）；Bergerault 等人（2026a）将这些评论扩展为对模仿学习更精确的刻画。 在非交互情形下，这些工作表明均衡提取的难度可以归约为可集中性与均衡处连续性的相关概念。此外，Freihaut 等人 （2026a）；Freihaut 等人 （2026b）展示了如何在交互式设置中通过强制探索状态空间以覆盖不确定的偏离，来优化此类纳什间隙遗憾。 这是通过依次控制所有智能体来实现的。 我们认为，这种对智能体的控制在许多场景中并不现实，在这些场景中智能体在学习时并不协作，例如在现实世界环境中从与（部分）对抗玩家的交互中学习时。 为此，我们采用 Stackelberg 目标来衡量所提取策略的最优性，即评估领导者与其他策略性玩家一起部署时的表现。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, imitation learning extracts a policy from (approximately) optimal agents corresponding to fixed incentives. paragraphs.en: This ambiguity on the reward function has first been explored in the single-agent case, with the analysis of potential-based transformations or potential shaping originating from Ng et al. (1999) . In the normal-form game setting, these transformations reduce to constant shifts, whose invariance to optimal policies carry over to the entropy-regularized setting (i.e. softmax policies remain invariant to constant shifts of the rewards). The picture extends to games, where each individual reward is contained in an individual feasible reward set. In this scenario, even the nature of the game (e.g. cooperative, zero-sum) can sometimes not be identifiable from the feasible sets alone ( Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 关于奖励函数的这种模糊性最早在单智能体情形中被探讨，Ng et al. (1999) 提出的基于势的变换或势塑形分析即源于此。 在标准形式博弈的设定下，这些变换退化为常数平移，而其对最优策略的不变性可以延续到熵正则化的设定中（即 softmax 策略对奖励的常数平移保持不变）。 这幅图景可以推广到博弈中，其中每个个体的奖励都包含在一个个别的可行奖励集合之内。 在这种情形下，有时甚至连博弈的性质（例如合作博弈、零和博弈）也无法仅凭可行集合加以辨识（Freihaut and Ramponi, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate this issue, one could consider learning in different environments, as pointed out by Rolland et al. (2022) ; Freihaut and Ramponi (2026) . A second possibility is to weaken the exact identifiability objective, which aims to exactly learn the reward function, in particular by minimizing the mismatch with the ground truth in the Euclidean norm ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . Our work applies both propositions, where the learner agent induces different environments to the soft-optimal follower, and where only the strategic identifiability of its reward is considered.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这一问题，如 Rolland 等人 （2022）；Freihaut 和 Ramponi（2026）所指出的，可以考虑在不同环境中学习。 第二种可能性是弱化精确可辨识性目标，该目标旨在精确学习奖励函数，特别是通过在欧几里得范数下最小化与真实值的失配来实现（Liao 等人，2025）。 我们的工作同时采用了这两种方案：学习方智能体向软最优跟随者诱导不同的环境，并且只考虑其奖励的策略性可辨识性。

paragraphs.en: In the single-agent case, the seminal work of Ziebart et al. (2008) develops MaxEntIRL , an algorithm recovering the reward matching the maximum-entropy solution given by the demonstrations. The proposed method operates under linear rewards. Their method essentially boils down to gradient descent on the reward parameters, where gradients, given by expected features, are approximated from rollouts of the policy in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在单智能体情形下，Ziebart 等人的开创性工作 （2008）提出了 MaxEntIRL，一种从演示中恢复与最大熵解相匹配的奖励的算法。 所提出的方法在线性奖励下运行。 他们的方法本质上归结为对奖励参数进行梯度下降，其中由期望特征给出的梯度通过该策略在环境中的 rollout 来近似。

paragraphs.en: MaxEntIRL has later been empirically extended to games by Mehr et al. (2023) , and the theoretical guarantees of such extensions in terms of strategic exploitability are yet to be understood. Furthermore, one caveat of this method is the requirement that all players are controllable, which can be unreasonable in various applications. In contrast, we develop in this work a principled algorithm with PAC guarantees under a finite number of samples. In our two-player setting, only one agent is assumed controllable, while the non-controllable agent (the follower) is best-responding to the learner (the leader policy).

paragraphs.en: An offline warm-up allows to directly optimize a set of exploratory policies to reduce the maximum uncertainty. However, during this offline phase we cannot collect information about the unknown reward coefficients, which prevents the algorithm to query the best-responding player in the optimal directions.

paragraphs.en: We therefore perform optimal design assuming a uniform best-responding agents (i.e. ω = 0 ∈ Ω \omega=0\in\Omega ), and pay for this choice with a global self-concordance introducing an exponential term κ \kappa in the burn-in phase for exploration. This exponential dependency is then removed in the online phase, which relies on a running estimate for ω \omega (namely, the maximum likelihood estimator).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们在假设智能体均匀做出最优响应（即 ω=0∈Ω）的条件下进行最优设计，并为这一选择付出代价：引入全局自洽性，从而在用于探索的预燃烧阶段引入指数项 κ。 这一指数依赖随后在在线阶段被消除，该阶段依赖于对 ω 的运行估计（即最大似然估计量）。

paragraphs.en: Active algorithms. These methods are implemented with and without an initial warm-up phase (using Algorithm 2 ), and are operating under the assumption of a follower best-response oracle, given a leader policy that is actively selected.
paragraphs.zh: 活跃算法。 这些方法在有和没有初始预热阶段（使用算法 2）的情况下实现，并在跟随者最佳响应预言机的假设下运行，同时主动选择一个领导者策略。

sents.en: Active algorithms.
sents.zh: 活跃算法。

sents.en: These methods are implemented with and without an initial warm-up phase (using Algorithm 2 ), and are operating under the assumption of a follower best-response oracle, given a leader policy that is actively selected.
sents.zh: 这些方法在有和没有初始预热阶段（使用算法 2）的情况下实现，并在跟随者最佳响应预言机的假设下运行，同时主动选择一个领导者策略。

paragraphs.en: Active IRL (ours): An implementation of Algorithm 1 .
paragraphs.zh: Active IRL（我们的方法）：算法 1 的一种实现。

paragraphs.en: Fixed random : An MLE-based reward extraction similar to Algorithm 1 , where the leader policy is randomly sampled then kept fixed throughout all online iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 固定随机：一种基于 MLE 的奖励提取方法，类似于算法 1，其中领导智能体策略被随机采样后，在所有在线迭代过程中保持固定。

paragraphs.en: Online random : A similar MLE-based algorithm using a new randomly sampled leader policy at each online iteration.
paragraphs.zh: Online random：一种类似的基于 MLE 的算法，在每次在线迭代时使用一个新的随机采样的领导者策略。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-expert algorithms. These methods assume access to a fixed expert, from which they can collect samples. The expert is defined with respect to a fixed (but unknown) leader reward, which is also in contrast to active algorithms.
paragraphs.zh: 固定专家算法。 这些方法假设可以访问一个固定的专家，并从该专家那里收集样本。 该专家是相对于一个固定（但未知）的主导者奖励定义的，这一点也与主动算法形成对比。

sents.en: Fixed-expert algorithms.
sents.zh: 固定专家算法。

sents.en: These methods assume access to a fixed expert, from which they can collect samples.
sents.zh: 这些方法假设可以访问一个固定的专家，并从该专家那里收集样本。

sents.en: The expert is defined with respect to a fixed (but unknown) leader reward, which is also in contrast to active algorithms.
sents.zh: 该专家是相对于一个固定（但未知）的主导者奖励定义的，这一点也与主动算法形成对比。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-expert MLE : Uses the same constrained MLE as the active methods, but fixing the policy as a known Stackelberg optimal leader.
paragraphs.zh: 固定专家 MLE：使用与主动方法相同的受约束 MLE，但将策略固定为已知的 Stackelberg 最优领导者。

paragraphs.en: Follower-only OLS : Recovering the ordinary least-square solution of the empirical version of the linear system of Equation 6 . This assumes access to an entropy-regularized joint-QRE expert oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 仅跟随者OLS：恢复方程6的线性系统的经验版本的普通最小二乘解。 这假设可以访问一个熵正则化的联合QRE专家神谕。

sents.zh: 仅跟随者OLS：恢复方程6的线性系统的经验版本的普通最小二乘解。

sents.en: This assumes access to an entropy-regularized joint-QRE expert oracle.

paragraphs.en: We provide additional experiments using the Lobéké National Park environment from the GUARD benchmark ( Krever et al., 2026 ) , in the same setup as in the main text. We describe it below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GUARD 基准（Krever et al., 2026）中的洛贝凯国家公园（Lobéké National Park）环境，在与正文相同的设置下提供了补充实验。我们在下文中对其进行介绍。

paragraphs.en: Task The environment models an anti-poaching scenario in the Lobéké National Park (Cameroon), designed from a dataset of recorded elephant movements. This classical green security game involves patrols (leader player) to protect wildlife against poachers (follower player). Both players distribute in the park and the followers are rewarded based on the area they occupy (as they can poach more animals) and the presence of patrols (as patrols are limiting their capacity to poach). On the other hand, the patrols can be incentivized in minimizing the rewards for the poachers, but also in trading-off this objective with the covering of prioritized areas.
paragraphs.zh: 任务 该环境模拟了洛贝凯国家公园（喀麦隆）的反偷猎场景，其设计基于记录大象移动情况的数据集。 这是一个经典的绿色安全博弈，其中巡逻方（领导者智能体）保护野生动物免遭偷猎者（跟随者智能体）的侵害。 双方都在公园内分布，跟随者根据其占据的区域（因为它们可以偷猎更多动物）以及巡逻队的存在（因为巡逻队限制了它们偷猎的能力）获得奖励。 另一方面，巡逻队可以被激励去最小化偷猎者的奖励，但同时也要在这一目标与覆盖优先区域之间进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: Model (illustrated in Figure 4 ) The game is model as a 5 × 5 5\times 5 grid comprised of 23 23 accessible locations. A ranger action action a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} is one of the 23 23 feasible ten-step patrol schedules generated by GUARD, while the follower response b ∈ ℬ b\in\mathcal{B} is the choice of one of the 23 23 targets. At a given time step t t , the leader first chooses a distribution over patrol schedules, to which the follower reacts by choosing a location distribution, modeled as the entropy-regularized best-response to the patrol policy. Taking the role of the leader and observing sampled actions b t ∼ ν μ t ∗ b_{t}\sim\nu^{*}_{\mu_{t}} , the learner can therefore learn information about the follower’s reward and, in the active case, adapt its subsequent patrol policies.
paragraphs.zh: 模型（如图 4 所示）该博弈被建模为一个由 23 个可访问位置组成的 5 × 5 网格。 护林员的动作 action a ∈ 𝒜 是由 GUARD 生成的 23 个可行的十步巡逻方案之一，而跟随者的响应 b ∈ ℬ 是从 23 个目标中选择其一。 在给定时间步 t，领导者首先选择巡逻方案上的一个分布，跟随者则通过选择位置分布作出反应，该分布被建模为对巡逻策略的熵正则化最优响应。 因此，以领导者身份观察采样动作 b_t ∼ ν*_{μ_t} 的学习者可以学习到关于跟随者奖励的信息，并且在主动情况下，还能调整其后续的巡逻策略。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate how the different algorithms perform for the target task and show how they transfer to multiple downstream tasks, without additional interactions in the environment.

paragraphs.en: As can be seen on Figure 5 , our algorithm Active IRL presents a real advantage in terms of transfer to multiple downstream tasks compared to fixed-expert methods, and outperforms the other active method baselines. For the target task, the gap with the Fixed-expert MLE algorithm is significantly reduced, but our algorithm remains competitive without assuming access to a fixed-expert oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 如图5所示，我们的算法 Active IRL 在迁移到多个下游任务方面相比固定专家方法展现出真正的优势，并且优于其他主动方法基线。 对于目标任务，与固定专家 MLE 算法的差距显著缩小，但我们的算法在不需要访问固定专家预言机的情况下仍具有竞争力。

paragraphs.en: We now highlight the benefits of active policy selection by designing a game where the Fisher information is very sparse, i.e. most of the possible leader actions are not informative for learning ω \omega . To this end, we set up a game with m m leader actions, such that only the first leader action affects the follower’s reward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在通过设计一个 Fisher 信息非常稀疏的博弈来突出主动策略选择的好处，即大多数可能的领导者动作对于学习 ω \omega 都不提供信息。 为此，我们构建了一个包含 m m 个领导者动作的博弈，其中只有第一个领导者动作会影响跟随者的奖励。

paragraphs.en: For this experiment, we report results for Active IRL without warm-up to isolate the online policy-selection behavior of our algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 在本实验中，我们报告了不带预热（warm-up）的 Active IRL 的结果，以分离出我们算法的在线策略选择行为。

paragraphs.en: As can be seen in Figure 9 , our algorithm Active IRL is able to quickly learn ω \omega and thus minimizing the sub-optimality of the computed policy μ ^ \hat{\mu} . In comparison, the two baselines are not able to find useful information efficiently. As expected, the performance discrepancy is increasing with the number of leader actions m m .
paragraphs.zh: 如图 9 所示，我们的算法 Active IRL 能够快速学习 ω \omega，从而最小化所计算策略 μ ^ \hat{\mu} 的次优性。 相比之下，两个基线方法都无法高效地找到有用信息。 正如预期，性能差距随着领导者动作数量 m m 的增加而增大。
